study: Temporal concentration of historical phase/amp-change proxies, not true onset detection
evidence: Hilbert along189 range bins; subtract full90-frame complex mean; sum_range sqrt(abs(z[t+1]*conj(z[t])))*abs(angle(product)), and sum_range abs(abs(z[t+1])-abs(z[t])). No per-clip standardization, no view fusion. Normalize each nonnegative89-transition series by its own sum; total<=1e-20 invalid. No duplicated first increment.
interval: Earliest shortest continuous interval retaining>=90%-1e-12 of each proxy separately and both jointly. Transition[start,end) corresponds to raw frames[start,end], length=end-start+1. Invalid evidence gets full90-frame interval and never votes for cropping.
decision: Only if at least one view has>=50% of all records with valid joint90%-mass intervals<=60 raw frames in>=4/6 source users, consider a future controlled crop study. Otherwise stop this energy-preserving crop premise; no threshold/mass/proxy grid. Passing is not automatic training authorization by evidence: semantic preservation remains untested.
label_use: Labels used only for fixed historical quality mask; no class scores, fitting, model selection, or test-user signals read for analysis. Raw whole-file hashing is integrity checking, not analysis.
limits: Original P0 already observed high15-segment fused entropy; new quantity is continuous mass-retaining extent and agreement of two per-view proxies, not a new activity target
Energy may include noise or low-level movement, and low-energy portions can be semantically essential
Full-clip mean and earlier clutter removal prevent claims of causal online onset/early recognition
No verified onset labels, frame timing or per-frame inter-radar synchronization
This numeric 90%/60-frame screen is a preregistered engineering criterion, not a literature theorem or success definition for the research goal
